tools.description: Project settings, durations, and counts.

tools.description: Media library items (blob-free).

tools.description: Compact clip list. Optional filters: trackIndex, fromSec, toSec; paginate huge timelines with offset/limit.

tools.description: Full detail for one clip by id.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Valid enums + parameter ranges.

tools.name: get_creation_capabilities
tools.description: Agent-native creation vocabulary, supported editable 3D object/material/environment kinds, and the preferred create/sync/preview/edit workflow.

tools.name: get_creation_history
tools.description: List recent persisted creation operations (asset/scene/camera/scene-object/animation upserts and removals) with their source, label, and target ids — for agent review panels, audit, and undo planning. Optional sceneId filter and limit (default 50).

tools.name: critique_creation_scene
tools.description: Analyze a persisted creation scene and return warnings plus suggested next tools: empty scenes, objects missing assets/materials, missing/stale/partial render bindings, no camera/lights, unbaked (dirty) mesh caches, and orphaned animation tracks. Use this in agent review loops before rendering or exporting.

tools.name: solve_creation_ik
tools.description: Compute two-bone (upper + lower limb) inverse kinematics with the CPU rig solver: given a root/shoulder position, a target/hand position, and bone lengths, returns the elbow joint position and whether the target is reachable. Use this to plan character arm/leg poses to grip props or reach points before authoring keyframes.

tools.name: evaluate_creation_material_graph
tools.description: Evaluate a node-based material graph (color/scalar/mix/multiply/output nodes) with the CPU material engine to a final PBR descriptor (baseColor, metallic, roughness, emissive). Use this to resolve procedural material networks to concrete renderable values.

tools.name: simulate_creation_cloth
tools.description: Run the CPU mass-spring cloth solver for a flag/sheet and return the simulated mesh statistics (vertex/triangle counts, bounds). Choose a pin edge (top/bottom/left/right/top-corners), plane (xy flag / xz hanging), gravity, wind, and steps. Use this to preview cloth motion before binding it into a scene.

tools.name: probe_rigging_backend
tools.description: Check whether the desktop Blender rigging backend is available before attempting character rigging, animation retargeting, or GLB cleanup jobs.

tools.name: inspect_3d_model
tools.description: Load and inspect a GLB/glTF model before rigging, retargeting, animation binding, cleanup, or scene placement. Returns mesh/material/texture counts, bounds, animation clips, armature/bone summary, warnings, and suggested next MCP tools. Provide modelUrl directly, or resolve an existing model with compositionId+layerId(+objectId), sceneId+creationObjectId, or assetId.

tools.name: rig_humanoid_model
tools.description: Run the desktop Blender rigging backend to create or repair a humanoid armature for a GLB/glTF model and export a rigged GLB. Use inspect_3d_model first to confirm meshes/armature/animations. Provide modelUrl directly, or resolve an existing model with compositionId+layerId(+objectId), sceneId+creationObjectId, or assetId. outputPath is optional; when omitted the desktop backend writes a temporary GLB and returns outputUrl/outputPath. overwriteExisting=true replaces an existing armature; false preserves one when present.

tools.name: list_motion_compositions
tools.description: Compact list of Motion Creator scenes, layers, variables, and editor instances.

tools.name: list_creation_assets
tools.description: Compact list of persisted OpenReel creation assets/recipes generated or edited by agents.

tools.name: list_creation_scenes
tools.description: Compact list of persisted semantic 3D creation scenes, including object/camera/light/animation counts.

tools.name: get_creation_asset
tools.description: Full persisted creation asset recipe by assetId, including recipe nodes, materials, dependencies, and cache refs.

tools.name: get_creation_scene
tools.description: Full persisted semantic creation scene by sceneId. Omitting sceneId returns the active scene when one exists.

tools.name: inspect_creation_product_parts
tools.description: Compact edit map for semantic product/creation scene parts: object ids, part ids, asset/material ids, render bindings, recipe features, cache status, and animation clips. Use this before editing product internals, exploded views, X-ray shells, materials, callouts, or part motion.

tools.name: validate_creation_state
tools.description: Validate persisted creation assets/scenes for broken references, invalid active scene/camera ids, and animation target issues.

tools.name: set_creation_object_transform
tools.description: Update a semantic creation scene object's 3D transform and sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d render object when a render binding exists. Position/rotation/scale accept objects {x,y,z}; shorthand x/y/z, rotationX/Y/Z, scaleX/Y/Z are also supported. Existing bound scene-object keyframes are shifted so the rendered animation follows the edit.

tools.name: set_creation_object_material
tools.description: Assign and/or edit the material for a semantic creation scene object, then sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d render object when a render binding exists. Use this for agent-native product part restyling: chips, glass, shells, lenses, boards, batteries, and other semantic parts.

tools.name: apply_creation_material_preset
tools.description: Apply a production-friendly semantic material preset to a creation scene object and sync the bound scene3d render material. Presets include brushed-titanium, polished-aluminum, ceramic-glass, oled-screen, silicon-chip, copper-trace, matte-plastic, rubber-gasket, lunar-dust, and flag-fabric. Stores preset/procedural texture metadata on the creation material and dirties generated material/render caches for future native material baking.

tools.name: apply_creation_xray_material
tools.description: Make selected semantic creation objects render as editable X-ray/ghosted materials so product internals, cutaways, and exploded assemblies are visible. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; omit selection to target visible selectable objects. The tool updates creation material recipes, stores xray material metadata, dirties generated caches, and syncs bound scene3d material opacity immediately.

tools.name: apply_creation_surface_detail
tools.description: Add editable procedural surface detail such as scratches, dust, fingerprints, smudges, edge wear, or grime to selected creation scene objects. Stores material/texture recipe metadata, dirties generated caches for future native texture baking, and syncs a realtime roughness/metalness preview to the bound scene3d render objects.

tools.name: apply_creation_material_graph
tools.description: Evaluate a node-based material graph (color/scalar/mix/multiply/output nodes) and apply the resolved PBR descriptor (base color, metallic, roughness, emissive) to selected creation scene objects' materials, syncing the bound scene3d render objects. Use this to drive a procedural material network onto product/scene surfaces.

tools.name: add_creation_procedural_texture
tools.description: Apply an editable procedural base texture/pattern (noise, voronoi, fbm, marble, circuit, fabric-weave, lunar-dust, hex-grid, gradient, brushed) to selected creation objects' materials. Stores texture recipe metadata and a texture cache reference, dirties generated caches for future native baking, and syncs a realtime base-color/roughness/metalness preview to the bound scene3d render objects. Use this for circuit-board chips, fabric suits, lunar terrain, brushed metal, and stylized patterns.

tools.name: export_creation_scene_gltf
tools.description: Bake an entire persisted creation scene into one merged CPU-generated triangle mesh and return scene poly stats, per-object stats, and (by default) a glTF 2.0 export with embedded geometry. This composes the procedural primitive recipes with each object's transform. Use it to export a finished creation scene as a real 3D asset or to inspect total scene geometry. model/text3d objects are exported as placeholder boxes until native generators exist.

tools.name: render_creation_scene_image
tools.description: Render a persisted creation scene to a real image with the built-in deterministic CPU renderer: bakes the scene mesh, projects it through the scene camera, and returns coverage stats plus (by default) a PNG data URI. mode='raster' (default) z-buffers and Lambert-shades; mode='raytrace' casts primary rays with optional hard shadows for a final-quality preview. This is the CPU render/preview fallback (§7.12) — independent of the WebGPU/scene3d renderer — useful for headless previews and visual-regression checks.

tools.name: bake_creation_asset
tools.description: Bake a persisted creation asset's procedural recipe into a real CPU-generated triangle mesh, update its mesh cache to ready with bounds and vertex/triangle stats, and optionally return a glTF 2.0 export. Resolve the asset directly with assetId, or by an objectId/partId within a scene. Use quality 'preview' (default) or 'final'. model/text3d kinds remain placeholder caches until native generators exist.

tools.name: bake_creation_texture
tools.description: Bake a procedural texture for a creation object's material into a real CPU-generated image: compute its average color, mark a ready texture cache, optionally drive the realtime base color from the bake, and optionally return a PNG data URI. Resolves the material from an objectId/partId in a scene (or assetId + materialId). Pattern/colors default to the material's procedural-texture recipe when present. This is the CPU texture-bake reference (§7.11) behind a future native baker.

tools.name: set_creation_object_geometry
tools.description: Update what a semantic creation scene object is, then sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d render object when a render binding exists. Use this for replacing placeholders, changing primitive/model/text3d content, adjusting size/depth/aspect/cornerRadius/extrude/lidAngle, or swapping a GLB modelUrl while keeping creation state editable.

tools.name: remove_creation_scene_object
tools.description: Remove a semantic creation scene object and sync any bound Motion Creator scene3d render object. Cleans scene object references, optional child descendants, animation tracks, render binding entries, bound render objects, and bound object keyframes. Set removeAsset=true only when you want to delete the object's unused asset recipe too.

tools.name: apply_creation_bevel
tools.description: Apply an editable bevel/chamfer recipe node to selected semantic creation objects and sync a rounded preview into bound scene3d render objects. Use this for product body chamfers, lens rims, device corners, panels, buttons, packaging edges, and other high-quality hard-surface details that must remain adjustable rather than baked into a mesh.

tools.name: apply_creation_displacement
tools.description: Apply editable procedural displacement metadata to selected semantic creation objects and sync a terrain/relief preview into bound scene3d objects. Use this for moon terrain, craters, ridges, product grooves, fabric wrinkles, panel embossing, and rough environment surfaces while keeping the deformation as a recipe node for future native mesh baking.

tools.name: apply_creation_boolean
tools.description: Carve, fuse, intersect, or smooth-blend a semantic creation object's geometry with a procedural tool shape (sphere/box) using robust signed-distance-field CSG, then bake the real result into the bound scene3d viewport. Use this for device ports, speaker holes, button cutouts, lens cavities, camera cutouts, hollow shells, fused organic blobs, and metaball joins while keeping the operation editable as recipe nodes. Operations: subtract (carve), union (fuse), intersect, smooth-union (blend).

tools.name: apply_creation_array
tools.description: Repeat a semantic creation object's geometry into an editable row/grid of evenly-offset copies merged into one mesh, baked into the bound scene3d viewport. Use this for fences, railings, teeth, fins, columns, slats, keyboard keys, window grids, stair steps, and repeated hard-surface detail. Default offset is one mesh-width along X; set offsetX/offsetY/offsetZ for custom spacing. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags.

tools.name: apply_creation_texture_map
tools.description: Bake a procedural texture (noise, voronoi, fbm, marble, circuit, fabric-weave, lunar-dust, hex-grid, gradient, brushed, checker) into a real image and apply it as the surface MAP of selected creation objects, so the actual pattern shows in the bound scene3d viewport instead of a flat averaged color. Use this for circuit-board chips, brushed metal, marble, fabric suits, lunar terrain, hex panels, and patterned surfaces. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; control with pattern, colorA, colorB, scale, seed, textureSize.

tools.name: set_creation_scene_environment
tools.description: Update a semantic creation scene's environment, light rig, room/floor colors, and realtime scene3d lighting. Use this for cinematic moods, moon/space stages, product studios, dark stages, ground shadows, and background color changes while keeping creation state and bound render layers in sync.

tools.name: set_creation_camera
tools.description: Update a semantic creation scene camera and sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d camera. Omitting cameraId edits the active camera. Position/target accept objects {x,y,z}; shorthand posX/posY/posZ and targetX/targetY/targetZ are supported. Existing bound camera keyframes are shifted so camera moves keep their relative orbit/zoom.

tools.name: animate_creation_camera
tools.description: Create or replace semantic animation tracks for a creation scene camera and sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d camera keyframes. Use mode='orbit' for camera revolves around a target with optional radius push-in and FOV change, mode='dolly' for start/end position moves, mode='zoom' for FOV/focus moves, or pass explicit position/target/fov/focusDistance keyframe arrays. Position/target entries are {time,x,y,z,easing}; fov/focusDistance entries are {time,value,easing}.

tools.name: animate_creation_object
tools.description: Create or replace semantic animation tracks for a creation scene object and sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d render object when a render binding exists. Use this instead of animate_scene_object for agent-native product parts so the editable creation scene and rendered keyframes stay together. `position`, `rotation`, and `scale` are arrays of {time,x,y,z,easing}; `opacity` is {time,value,easing}. Re-calling replaces only the channels provided.

tools.name: animate_creation_exploded_view
tools.description: Create or replace a semantic multi-object exploded-view animation for agent-native product parts or arbitrary creation objects, store per-object exploded-view recipe metadata on the affected assets, dirty generated caches, and sync bound Motion Creator scene3d position keyframes. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; omit selection to animate all visible selectable scene objects.

tools.name: apply_creation_cloth_wave
tools.description: Add a first-pass procedural cloth/flag wave to a semantic creation object. This stores clothWave recipe metadata on the object's asset, adds a cloth recipe node, dirties generated caches, persists an editable animation clip, and syncs approximate scene3d rotation keyframes when a render binding exists. Use this for flags, fabric panels, ribbons, capes, and other simple cloth motion until a full cloth solver is available.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new blank project and make it active. Call this first when starting from scratch. Defaults to 1920x1080 at 30fps.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List saved projects (id + name + modifiedAt). Use an id with open_project. Recent project files on disk also appear with their `path`: open those with open_project_file.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a saved project by id and make it active.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Persist the active project so it can be reopened later.

tools.name: update_project_settings
tools.description: Update resolution/fps/etc. pixelAspectRatio (0.25-4, 1 = square) is the sequence pixel aspect: clips are squeezed by it so they keep their display shape. fieldOrder (progressive, upper, lower) is the sequence field order; a Bob deinterlace of interlaced footage keeps the field that matches it.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename the project.

tools.name: set_canvas_background
tools.description: Set background fill mode/color.

tools.name: add_track
tools.description: Add a track (video|audio|image|text|graphics).

tools.name: duplicate_track
tools.description: Duplicate a timeline-backed video, image, or audio track with fresh track, clip, and transition identities. Inserts the copy after the source unless position is supplied.

tools.name: remove_track
tools.description: Remove a track and its clips.

tools.name: rename_track
tools.description: Rename a track.

tools.name: reorder_track
tools.description: Move a track to a new stacking position (0 = top of the timeline / front-most).

tools.name: lock_track
tools.description: Lock/unlock a track.

tools.name: set_track_sync_lock
tools.description: Turn a track's Sync Lock on or off (default on). Ripple-type edits (ripple delete, ripple trim, insert, extract, paste-insert, close gap) keep sync-locked tracks in sync by shifting them with the edit, or are blocked (naming the track) when the removed range is not empty there; tracks with Sync Lock off are never touched by edits to other tracks. One undo step.

tools.name: hide_track
tools.description: Show/hide a track.

tools.name: mute_track
tools.description: Mute/unmute a track.

tools.name: set_track_solo_safe
tools.description: Turn Solo Safe on or off for a track. A solo-safe track keeps playing (preview and export mixdown) while other tracks are soloed; mute still silences it. Saved with the project. One undo step.

tools.name: solo_track
tools.description: Solo/unsolo a track.

tools.name: consolidate_track
tools.description: Remove Gaps: close every empty stretch on a track. Sync Lock: every other unlocked sync-locked track must be empty over each closed gap and shifts with it; otherwise the edit is blocked and the error names the track. Locked tracks are never changed. One undo step.

tools.name: import_media_from_url
tools.description: Download an image, video, or audio file from a public http(s) URL (e.g. a free stock library) and add it to the media library. Returns the mediaId to use with add_clip. Requires an open project.

tools.name: delete_media
tools.description: Delete a media library item.

tools.name: rename_media
tools.description: Rename a media item.

tools.name: add_clip
tools.description: Add a media clip to a track at a time.

tools.name: remove_clip
tools.description: Remove a clip.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.description: Move a clip to a new start time / track.

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.description: Trim an existing main-timeline clip by setting either or both source-media inPoint/outPoint values in seconds. Read the current values with get_clip first.

tools.name: split_clip
tools.description: Split an existing main-timeline clip at an absolute timeline time in seconds. The time must fall strictly inside the clip's startTime..startTime+duration range.

tools.name: slip_clip
tools.description: Slip a clip's source by delta.

tools.name: slide_clip
tools.description: Slide a clip by delta.

tools.name: roll_edit
tools.description: Roll the edit point between two clips.

tools.name: trim_to_playhead
tools.description: Trim a clip's start/end to a time.

tools.name: close_gap
tools.description: Close the gap before a clip. Sync Lock: every other unlocked sync-locked track must be empty over the gap and shifts with it; otherwise the edit is blocked. One undo step.

tools.name: set_clip_speed
tools.description: Set an existing main-timeline clip's playback-speed multiplier (for example 0.5 = half speed, 2 = double speed); recomputes its duration. Use get_capabilities speed.range for limits.

tools.name: set_clip_reverse
tools.description: Toggle clip reverse.

tools.name: set_clip_pitch_correction
tools.description: Toggle pitch correction on speed changes.

tools.name: set_speed_ramp
tools.description: Set speed keyframes / freeze frames / pitch.

tools.name: set_clip_stabilization
tools.description: Set clip stabilization settings.

tools.name: set_clip_chroma_key
tools.description: Set green-screen / chroma-key settings.

tools.name: set_clip_transform
tools.description: Update an existing main-timeline clip's static transform. position is a pixel offset from canvas center; scale uses 1 = 100%; rotation is degrees; opacity is 0..1. Partial nested updates are safely merged, so {scale:{x:1.2,y:1.2}} performs a 120% zoom without resetting position.

tools.name: set_clip_blend_mode
tools.description: Set a clip's blend mode.

tools.name: set_clip_blend_opacity
tools.description: Set a clip's blend opacity (0..1).

Standard effectType values include brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, sharpen, vignette, grain, temperature, tint, shadow, glow, motion-blur, radial-blur, chromatic-aberration. ripple (amplitude 0..200, wavelength 4..1000, angle 0..360, phase 0..360, speed -10..10, time 0..3600); turbulent-displace (amount 0..300, size 4..1000, complexity 1..4, evolution 0..1000, seed 0..9999); replicate (count 1..16); color-emboss (amount 0..100, angle 0..360, relief 0..10); noise (amount 0..100, size 1..32, mono boolean, time 0..3600, seed 0..9999); bevel-alpha (thickness 1..50, angle 0..360, intensity 0..100); four-color-gradient (c1R 0..255, c1G 0..255, c1B 0..255, c2R 0..255, c2G 0..255, c2B 0..255, c3R 0..255, c3G 0..255, c3B 0..255, c4R 0..255, c4G 0..255, c4B 0..255, opacity 0..100, blend normal|multiply|screen|add); Prefer the pro type where one supersedes a legacy effect (gaussian-blur over blur, mosaic over shader pixelate, mirror over shader mirror, lens-distortion over shader fisheye, posterize over shader posterize, vhs-glitch over shader vhs); the legacy types still render in existing projects. Omitted legacy params also take the editor's visible defaults. Pro effect params can be keyframed with add_keyframe property fx:<effectId>:<param> (effectId from get_clip or list_effect_params). tools.name: add_keyframe
tools.description: Animate an existing main-timeline clip by adding a property keyframe at clip-local time in seconds. Supported transform properties are opacity, position.x/y, scale.x/y, and rotation; effect parameters are keyed by effect INSTANCE as fx:<effectId>:<param> (effectId from get_clip / list_effect_params; two copies of an effect animate independently). Legacy type-keyed ids (effect.brightness/contrast/saturation/temperature/blur, effect.<proEffectType>.<param>) are still accepted only when the clip has exactly one effect of that type (it is rewritten onto that instance); no such effect, or several instances, is rejected, so prefer the fx id. Add at least two keyframes for interpolation.

property.description: Transform property (opacity, position.x/y, scale.x/y, rotation) or an effect parameter keyed by effect INSTANCE: fx:<effectId>:<param> (preferred; see list_effect_params). Legacy type-keyed ids (effect.brightness/contrast/saturation/temperature/blur, effect.<proEffectType>.<param>) are still accepted and are mapped onto the first effect of that type on the clip.

tools.name: remove_keyframe
tools.description: Remove a keyframe. Effect keyframes are keyed fx:<effectId>:<param>; legacy type-keyed ids resolve to the single matching effect and are rejected when the clip has several of that type (use the fx id).

tools.name: set_clip_keyframes

tools.name: create_motion_composition
tools.description: Create a standalone Motion Creator composition with starter layers. Useful for intros, lower thirds, ads, app demos, and reusable scene graphics.

tools.name: delete_motion_composition
tools.description: Delete a Motion Creator composition by compositionId. Destructive — removes the composition and any editor instances of it. Use to clean up throwaway or superseded comps.

tools.name: duplicate_motion_composition
tools.description: Deep-clone a Motion Creator composition into a new standalone composition with fresh ids for every layer, keyframe, mask, effect, text animator, expression, marker, light, and variable (no shared references); keyframe and expression property references to remapped mask/effect ids are rewritten to match. Optional name (defaults to '<name> Copy'). Returns the new compositionId.

tools.name: create_creation_3d_scene
tools.description: Create a semantic OpenReel creation scene and a renderable Motion Creator scene3d composition in one call. Use this for arbitrary agent-built 3D worlds, product stages, environment layouts, UI-in-3D mockups, props, labels, and cinematic setups that must remain editable. `objects` uses the same fields as add_motion_3d_scene plus optional key, objectId, assetId, assetKind, materialId, materialModel, tags, and parentKey. insertIntoEditor defaults to false so the scene stays in Motion Creator; set it true ONLY when the user explicitly wants the rendered scene placed on the main video-editor timeline. Returns semantic object ids and render object ids for follow-up set_creation_object_transform, set_creation_object_material, animate_creation_object, and set_creation_camera calls.

tools.name: recover_motion_scene3d_to_creation
tools.description: Convert an existing multi-object Motion Creator scene3d layer into editable semantic creation assets/objects and a motion-scene3d render binding. Use this for older MCP-created scenes that render in Motion Creator but show no Creation workspace objects. It preserves the existing render object ids and creates creation state in-place; call sync_creation_scene_to_motion afterward only if the render layer later needs rebuilding.

tools.name: sync_creation_scene_to_motion
tools.description: Create, repair, or refresh the Motion Creator scene3d composition/layer for a persisted semantic OpenReel creation scene. Use this when a creation scene exists but is not rendering, after project import/load recovery, after stale binding issues, or when agents need to regenerate the native scene3d layer from editable creation assets/objects/cameras/lights. Reuses an existing motion-scene3d render binding unless forceNew=true, and can insert the synced composition into the editor timeline.

tools.name: add_creation_scene_object
tools.description: Append one editable semantic object to an existing OpenReel creation scene and sync the bound Motion Creator scene3d layer when a render binding exists. Uses the same object fields as create_creation_3d_scene/add_motion_3d_scene plus optional key, objectId, renderObjectId, assetId, assetKind, materialId, materialModel, tags, parentId, and parentKey. Returns the creation object id and render object id for set_creation_object_transform, set_creation_object_material, and animate_creation_object.

tools.name: add_creation_product_part
tools.description: Add one editable semantic product part to an existing creation scene and sync it into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for product internals and details like shells, screens, lenses, camera modules, boards, batteries, chips, thermal layers, screws, connectors, gaskets, and decorative parts. The asset recipe gets a product-part node with role metadata so agents and professionals can inspect, animate, restyle, explode, label, or refine it later.

tools.name: add_creation_screen_stack
tools.description: Add an editable layered product display stack to an existing creation scene and sync every layer into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for product intros that need separate cover glass, OLED/display, digitizer, backplate, or custom display layers that can be exploded, labeled, restyled, animated, and recovered from semantic state.

tools.name: add_creation_camera_module
tools.description: Add an editable semantic camera module assembly to an existing creation scene and sync every component into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for product intros that need a camera island, lens rings, lens glass, sensors, flash, and optional depth sensor as separate parts that can be exploded, labeled, restyled, animated, and recovered from semantic state.

tools.name: add_creation_product_internals
tools.description: Add an editable semantic internal product layout to an existing creation scene and sync every component into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for product reveals that need a logic board, battery, chips, connectors, screws, and thermal layer as separate parts that can be exploded, labeled, restyled, animated, and recovered from semantic state.

tools.name: add_creation_light_sweep
tools.description: Add an editable animated highlight/light sweep to an existing creation scene and sync it into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for premium product intros, metal/glass glints, reveal passes, and final hero polish. The current preview is an emissive plane with semantic light-sweep recipe metadata and persisted position/opacity tracks.

tools.name: add_creation_character
tools.description: Build an editable recipe-driven humanoid character (pelvis, torso, neck, head, two arms with forearms and hands, two legs with feet, plus optional helmet, visor, and backpack) in a creation scene and sync every part into the bound scene3d layer. Each part is a separate semantic object carrying skeleton/bone metadata so agents and professionals can pose, animate, restyle, label, explode, or refine it later. Style presets: stylized, realistic, low-poly, robot, astronaut, mascot. Use pose_creation_character afterward for wave/idle/point/cheer gestures.

tools.name: pose_creation_character
tools.description: Apply an editable pose/gesture animation (wave, idle, point, cheer, t-pose, a-pose) to a creation character's arm/torso/head parts and sync the bound scene3d rotation keyframes. Select the character with characterId (returned by add_creation_character), or with objectIds/partIds/tags. `side` (left/right) chooses the waving/pointing arm. The animation is stored as an editable clip and survives scene-to-motion recovery.

tools.name: add_creation_particle_system
tools.description: Add an editable procedural particle system (stars, dust, sparks, embers, snow, confetti, bokeh) to a creation scene and sync every particle into the bound scene3d layer. Particles are deterministic seeded instances inside a box or sphere region, optionally with editable drift and twinkle animation. Stored with particle-system recipe metadata and an editable animation clip so the look survives scene-to-motion recovery.

tools.name: duplicate_creation_object
tools.description: Duplicate one semantic creation object into an independent editable variant (its own asset and material) and sync it into the bound scene3d layer. Use this for product color/material variants, A-B comparison shots, character crowd variants, or prop copies that must be styled independently. Apply color/metalness/roughness/opacity/emissive overrides and an offset/position. The variant survives scene-to-motion recovery.

tools.name: simulate_creation_rigid_drop
tools.description: Bake a deterministic rigid-body drop-and-settle simulation onto creation objects: each object falls under gravity from a drop height and bounces to rest, baked to editable position keyframes and synced into the bound scene3d layer. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; omit selection to drop all visible selectable objects. Use this for product parts dropping into place, assembly reveals, packaging drops, and terrain-contact settles. Stores rigid-drop recipe metadata and survives scene-to-motion recovery.

tools.name: simulate_creation_rigid_bodies
tools.description: Bake a deterministic rigid-body physics simulation onto creation objects: each object drops from an optional height under gravity and collides with the ground AND with the other selected objects (friction, restitution, settling, sleeping), baked to editable position keyframes and synced into the bound scene3d layer. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags. Use this for parts tumbling into a pile, debris settling, collision reveals, packaging fills, and physical stacking. Unlike simulate_creation_rigid_drop (which returns parts to their authored positions), this settles them on a shared ground plane with real inter-body collisions.

tools.name: bake_creation_cloth
tools.description: Bake a deterministic mass-spring (Verlet) cloth simulation onto a selected creation surface (a plane/panel) — pinned edges, gravity, damping, and wind — into a per-frame deforming mesh that plays in the bound scene3d viewport without keyframes (sampled by time). Use this for flags, capes, banners, fabric drapes, curtains, sails, and hanging cloth. Pin options: top, top-corners, left, right, bottom, none. Plane: xy (hanging) or xz (flat/flag). Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags.

tools.name: bake_creation_skinned_limb
tools.description: Turn a selected creation object into a smoothly-deforming skinned limb (a bone chain + linear-blend skinning) animated with a traveling-wave curl, baked into a per-frame deforming mesh that plays in the bound scene3d viewport. Unlike rigid primitive parts that pivot about their own origin, the limb bends SMOOTHLY at every joint. Use this for tentacles, tails, cables, hoses, snakes, vines, antennae, robot-arm segments, and waving appendages. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; control with segments, radius, amplitudeDegrees, frequency, speed, axis (x|z), fps, simDuration.

tools.name: bake_creation_humanoid
tools.description: Turn a selected creation object into a SKINNED humanoid character (pelvis/spine/chest/neck/head, two arms, two legs as one bone-rigged mesh) animated with a chosen motion — animation: wave (default), walk, idle, or point — baked into a per-frame deforming mesh that plays in the bound scene3d viewport. Unlike separate rigid primitive body parts, the character deforms SMOOTHLY at every joint (shoulders, elbows, hips, knees) via linear-blend skinning. Use this for agent-native characters, mascots, avatars, and figures. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; control with animation, speed, idleSway, fps, simDuration, radialSegments. The object's size sets the character height.

tools.name: bake_creation_particles
tools.description: Turn a selected creation object into a deterministic particle burst (stars, sparks, embers, confetti, dust, snow, debris) simulated under gravity, drag, and wind, baked into a per-frame deforming point-cloud mesh that plays in the bound scene3d viewport. Each particle is a small octahedron; dead particles fade out. Unlike approximate drift keyframes, the motion is the real Euler particle solver. Select with objectIds, partIds, or tags; control with count, speed, spread, gravity, drag, lifetime, wind, particleSize, seed, fps, simDuration.

tools.name: scatter_creation_objects
tools.description: Duplicate one semantic creation object into many editable scene instances using deterministic grid, line, ring, or seeded-random patterns, then sync the new instances into the bound scene3d layer. Use for moon rocks, screws, windows, debris, product fasteners, environment dressing, repeated interface elements, and other dense scene detail without hand-adding every object.

tools.name: add_creation_cutaway_plane
tools.description: Add an editable semantic cutaway plane to a creation/product scene and sync it as a translucent scene3d plane marker. The asset recipe stores normal/offset/target part metadata for future native clipping/boolean rendering while current previews show the cut plane visually.

tools.name: add_creation_decal
tools.description: Add an editable semantic decal/logo/marking to a creation scene surface and sync it as a scene3d plane or text3d object. Stores decal projection metadata on the asset recipe for future native texture baking while current previews show the decal as an editable render object.

tools.name: add_creation_ui_panel
tools.description: Add an editable 3D UI/screen/holographic panel to a creation scene and sync it as a scene3d plane with editable text3d child rows. Use it for device screens, spatial dashboards, product HUDs, and agent-authored interfaces that must remain semantic rather than baked video.

tools.name: create_product_cinematic_scene
tools.description: Create an editable high-detail product cinematic inside Motion Creator: a semantic multi-object 3D product assembly with materials, exploded-view animation, camera zoom/orbit keyframes, lights, room, and editable callout labels. insertIntoEditor defaults to false so it stays in Motion Creator; set it true ONLY when the user explicitly wants the rendered product cinematic placed on the main video-editor timeline.

tools.name: add_creation_product_callout
tools.description: Add an editable Motion text callout to a semantic product/creation scene and record it in the scene's motion-scene3d render binding. Use this after create_product_cinematic_scene or create_creation_3d_scene to label product parts, internals, materials, UI panels, or hero details. The returned text layer can be restyled or animated with normal Motion text tools.

tools.name: add_motion_layer
tools.description: Add a layer to a Motion Creator composition. layerType is one of text|shape|image|group|null|composition|adjustment|particle|scene3d. For image pass assetId (a composition asset id) or mediaId (a media library image). For composition pass refCompositionId (the nested comp to embed). scene3d creates a blank real-3D scene (one rounded-box hero object, studio lighting, default camera) — use set_motion_scene_object / add_motion_3d_object to populate it. For a bezier PEN shape set shapeType:'path' and supply pathData (an SVG path string, e.g. 'M 0 0 C 10 -20 40 -20 50 0') or pathPoints (an array of >=2 {x,y,inX?,inY?,outX?,outY?} vertices in layer-local pixels; in/out are absolute bezier handle coordinates) plus pathClosed (default true). Simple fields: name, text, color, width, height, shapeType.

tools.name: apply_motion_template
tools.description: Create a new Motion Creator composition from a built-in motion template/preset.

tools.name: generate_ad_scene
tools.description: Create a practical SaaS/product ad motion scene from headline/subheadline/brand color fields.

tools.name: animate_layer
tools.description: Author keyframes on a layer property (e.g. transform.opacity, transform.position.x, transform.scale.x, transform.rotation). Either pass from/to/startTime/endTime for a simple two-keyframe tween, or pass a `keyframes` array of { time, value, easing? } (>=2, strictly increasing times). Easing must be one of the known easing names (see get_capabilities motion.easings).

tools.name: list_motion_animatable_properties
tools.description: List the animatable properties of a motion layer (Transform always; Shape/Particle/Precomp by type; plus this layer's masks, effects, shape modifiers, and puppet pins), each with its current value at a time and every existing keyframe (id, time, value, easing, whether it has graph-editor bezier handles). Use this to discover keyframe ids before move/remove/re-ease, and to drive a graph-editor workflow.

tools.name: add_motion_keyframe
tools.description: Add or update a single keyframe at a time on a motion layer property (the AE 'stopwatch + set value at playhead' action). property is any animatable id: transform.* (e.g. transform.scale.x, transform.position.y, transform.opacity), shape.* (e.g. shape.cornerRadius), effect.<effectId>.<param>, mask.<maskId>.<prop> (prop = x|y|width|height|rotation|feather|expansion|opacity — mask bounds/feather keyframes), modifier.<modifierId>.<prop> (shape modifier fields, including repeater transform.position.x/y, transform.scale.x/y, transform.rotation, transform.opacity), and puppet.<pinId>.<prop>. Call list_motion_animatable_properties to enumerate the exact ids (including mask and modifier ids) for a layer. value defaults to the property's current value if omitted. easing is any known easing name. For a graph-editor curve, pass easing='bezier' with bezierIn {x,y} and bezierOut {x,y} normalized control points: bezierIn is P1 and bezierOut is P2 of the OUTGOING segment (this keyframe → the next one), normalized to that segment — x is the time fraction 0..1 across the segment and y is the value fraction of the segment's value delta. y may exceed [0,1] (e.g. y>1 overshoots past the target before settling, y<0 anticipates below the start). Re-calling at the same time updates that keyframe in place. roving (boolean) marks a middle keyframe as roving: its time is then AUTO-DERIVED (dropped from your input) so the property moves at constant speed between the surrounding non-roving anchor keyframes. A property's first and last keyframes can NEVER rove — requesting roving on an endpoint is a no-op. Toggling roving off restores an editable time.

tools.name: move_motion_keyframe
tools.description: Retime a single existing keyframe (by keyframeId) to a new time on a motion layer — like dragging a key in the AE timeline. Get keyframeIds from list_motion_animatable_properties. If another keyframe of the same property already sits at the new time, they merge.

tools.name: remove_motion_keyframe
tools.description: Delete a single keyframe (by keyframeId) from a motion layer, or pass property to clear ALL keyframes on that property (turn the property back into a static value). Get keyframeIds from list_motion_animatable_properties.

tools.name: sync_motion_to_audio
tools.description: Sync a motion composition to audio. If a `mediaId` (or audioClipId referencing audio with waveform data) is given, real beat markers are detected from the waveform; otherwise a beat grid is generated from `bpm`. Optional `sensitivity` (0-1, higher detects more beats) and `startTime` (seconds offset for the grid/detection). Also adds an intensity variable. Returns `markerTimes` (the beat times in seconds) so you can drive follow-up keyframing.

tools.name: set_motion_beat_markers
tools.description: Set the composition's beat markers explicitly from an array of `times` (seconds). Replaces any existing beat markers. Optional `strengths` (parallel array, 0-1; defaults to 1) and `bpm` (recorded on the beat analysis). Use apply_motion_preset_to_beats to animate a layer on these beats. Returns the marker times.

tools.name: remove_motion_beat_marker
tools.description: Remove a single beat marker from the composition by its `index` (0-based position in the beat marker list). Remaining markers are re-indexed. Returns the updated marker times.

tools.name: apply_motion_preset_to_beats
tools.description: Apply an animation preset to a layer at every detected beat (run sync_motion_to_audio or set_motion_beat_markers first). presetId is one of the get_capabilities motion.animationPresets (e.g. pulse, scale-pop, fade-in). Optional: duration (per-beat, capped to the gap to the next beat), onlyDownbeats (bool), distance, intensity, startTime, endTime, maxBeats. Fails if the composition has no beat markers.

tools.name: insert_motion_into_editor
tools.description: Place a motion composition into the normal video-editor timeline as a reusable rendered scene.

tools.name: get_motion_composition
tools.description: Full detail for one Motion Creator composition: every layer with its id, type, transform, keyframes, and type-specific fields, plus variables, markers, beat markers, camera, and lights. Use this to recover auto-generated layer ids before animating or editing.

tools.name: render_motion_frame
tools.description: Render a Motion Creator composition to a still image at a given time so YOU can SEE the current result and self-correct (layout, z-order, color, text wrap). Inputs: compositionId (required), timeSeconds (default 0), scale (1-2 supersample), quality ('draft' = 1x fast, 'final' = 2x supersampled). An explicit scale overrides quality. Returns the image attached to the result. Expensive — requires confirmation.

tools.name: render_creation_preview
tools.description: Render a still preview image for a semantic OpenReel creation scene by resolving its bound Motion Creator scene3d composition/layer. Use this after create_creation_3d_scene, sync_creation_scene_to_motion, or product cinematic creation to visually inspect agent-native creation work. If the binding/composition/layer is missing, call sync_creation_scene_to_motion first.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_transform
tools.description: Set a layer's static transform without keyframes. Optional: x, y (pixel center), z (depth for 3D-enabled layers), scale (uniform), scaleX, scaleY, rotation (degrees, Z axis), rotationX, rotationY, rotationZ (3D Euler degrees), perspective (camera distance in px for the preserve-3d container), opacity (0-1), anchorX, anchorY (pixels). Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_name
tools.description: Rename any layer in a composition. name is the new label shown in the timeline/layer list (must be non-empty).

tools.name: duplicate_motion_layer
tools.description: Duplicate one or more layers (with their keyframes, effects, masks, and expressions). Pass either layerId (single) or layerIds (array). Groups duplicate their descendants too. Copies are offset 32px and named "<name> Copy". Returns duplicatedLayerIds (the new top-level copies, in request order).

tools.name: set_motion_layer_solo
tools.description: Toggle a layer's solo flag. solo=true isolates soloed layers in preview/render (all non-soloed, non-guide layers are hidden). solo=false clears it.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_guide
tools.description: Toggle a layer's guideLayer flag. guideLayer=true marks it a non-rendering reference layer (visible in the editor, excluded from export). guideLayer=false makes it render normally.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_3d
tools.description: Toggle a 2D layer's 3D container mode. preserve3d=true sets transform.transformStyle='preserve-3d' so the layer and its children compose in a shared 3D space (needed for nested 3D rotations/perspective). preserve3d=false resets to 'flat'.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_timing
tools.description: Move a layer on the timeline by setting its startTime and/or duration (seconds). Values snap to the composition frame rate and are clamped to be non-negative; duration and the resulting out point are clamped to the composition duration. Pass at least one of startTime, duration; only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: trim_motion_layer
tools.description: Trim a layer's in or out point to a composition-time (seconds). edge='in' moves startTime to time (holding the out point fixed); edge='out' moves the end to time (holding startTime fixed). Values snap to the frame rate; a minimum duration is enforced.

tools.name: split_motion_layer
tools.description: Split a layer into two at a composition-time (seconds). The original keeps the first half; a new layer covers the second half (with its keyframes shifted). time must fall strictly inside the layer's span. Returns layerIds: [firstHalfId, secondHalfId].

tools.name: slip_motion_layer
tools.description: Slip a layer's source content by delta seconds while holding its timeline startTime and duration fixed (shifts the layer's timeOffset by delta scaled by playbackRate). Only layers with a source time offset (precomp/composition and video layers) can slip; others are rejected.

tools.name: ripple_delete_motion_layer
tools.description: Delete a layer and pull every later layer earlier by the deleted layer's duration, closing the gap it left (AE ripple delete). Locked layers are held in place unless includeLocked=true.

tools.name: ripple_motion_layers
tools.description: Shift every layer whose startTime is at or after fromTime (seconds) later or earlier by delta seconds, opening or closing time as a block (AE ripple insert/remove). Positive delta pushes layers later; negative pulls them earlier. Locked layers are held in place unless includeLocked=true; excludeLayerIds pins specific layers regardless. delta must be non-zero.

tools.name: create_motion_null_controller
tools.description: Create a null layer positioned at the average of the given layers and parent all of them to it, so transforming the null drives them together (AE null-object rig). layerIds is required (non-null layers only). Optional: name, guideColor (#hex). Returns controllerLayerId.

tools.name: add_motion_guide
tools.description: Add a ruler guide to the composition canvas. orientation is 'vertical' (a vertical line at x=position) or 'horizontal' (a horizontal line at y=position); position is in pixels. Optional: color (#hex), locked. Returns guideId.

tools.name: move_motion_guide
tools.description: Move an existing composition guide to a new position (pixels along its axis). Clamped to the composition bounds. Locked guides do not move unless includeLocked=true.

tools.name: remove_motion_guide
tools.description: Remove a ruler guide from the composition canvas by guideId.

tools.name: set_motion_scene3d_lighting
tools.description: Set lighting + image-based environment on a scene3d layer (EEVEE-class Three.js renderer). Optional: environment (studio|warm|cool|sunset|city|dark|none), environmentUrl (equirect .hdr/.exr/.jpg/.png world map for reflections + lighting), environmentBackground (show the env as the backdrop), groundShadow, ambient, keyIntensity, rimIntensity (0-10), keyColor (#hex). Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: reorder_motion_layer
tools.description: Change a layer's stacking order in the composition. mode is front | back | forward | backward | to-index (with index). Later layers in composition.layers render on top.

tools.name: remove_motion_layer
tools.description: Delete one or more layers from a composition. Pass `layerId` and/or `layerIds` (array). Child layers parented to a removed layer are removed too, and dangling track-matte references are cleared. Use to clean up starter layers or iterate on a build.

tools.name: update_motion_composition
tools.description: Update a composition's top-level settings. Optional: name, width, height, frameRate, duration, backgroundColor. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: import_motion_font
tools.description: Register a custom font on a composition so text layers can use it. Inputs: family (required), source (required URL or data: URI for a woff2/woff/ttf/otf), weight?, style? (normal|italic). Appends to composition.fonts.

tools.name: set_motion_text_style
tools.description: Set the full visual style of a text layer. Optional: fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, color, align (left|center|right), lineHeight, letterSpacing, maxWidth (px, enables word wrap), verticalAlign (top|middle|bottom), fillGradient { type: linear|radial|conic, angle, center {x,y}, stops:[{offset,color,opacity?}] }, shadow { color, blur, offsetX, offsetY, spread?, inset? }, stroke { color, width, over? } (outline around glyphs; width 0 clears it, over:true paints on top of the fill), backgroundColor, backgroundPadding, backgroundRadius. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: set_motion_text_content
tools.description: Replace the source text string of an existing text layer. Only mutates the layer's `.text`; styling, animators, and keyframes are untouched. Pass an empty string to clear the text. The layer referenced by layerId must be a text layer (else INVALID_PARAMS).

tools.name: attach_motion_expression
tools.description: Attach an expression to an animatable layer property. expressionType is a preset (sine|wiggle|drift|spring|loop|ping-pong|random|posterize) or 'expression' for a custom JavaScript expression supplied via `code`. Custom code may be a single expression ('value + 1') OR a multi-line body with an explicit return ('const a = value * 2;\nreturn a + 1;'). Scope: value, time, valueAtTime(t) (this property's pre-expression value at t), thisLayer (.index/.name/.value(propertyId)/.valueAtTime(propertyId,t)), key(n) (1-based -> {index,time,value}), numKeys, nearestKey(t), thisComp (.layer(nameOrIndex)/.numLayers/.duration/.width/.height/.frameRate), layer(nameOrIndex) -> handle whose .value(propertyId)/.valueAtTime(propertyId,t) fully evaluate another layer (its keyframes + its own expressions), effect(name)(paramName) reading an expression-control param, plus wiggle(freq,amp), loopOut() (cycle), linear(), ease(), clamp(), random(), Math. Cross-layer references are cycle-guarded (A<->B loops fall back to pre-expression values, never hang) and depth-capped at 8. On error the value falls back to the property base and the message is surfaced in the editor. For the built-in presets you may tune amplitude, frequency (cycles/sec), phase (offset), seed (random stream), and decay (spring settle) — omitted knobs use the preset's default (e.g. a slow wide wiggle is amplitude 60, frequency 0.5). Replaces any existing expression on that property.

tools.name: remove_motion_expression
tools.description: Remove an expression from a layer by expressionId.

tools.name: update_motion_expression
tools.description: Patch an existing expression in place (keeps its id, property, and enabled flag). Optional fields — only the ones you pass change: code (custom JavaScript body/expression), amplitude, frequency (cycles/sec), phase (offset), seed (random stream), decay (spring settle). Unlike attach_motion_expression this does NOT regenerate the id or reset untouched knobs, so it is the non-destructive way to tune a wiggle/spring/etc or repair a custom code string.

tools.name: toggle_motion_expression
tools.description: Enable or disable an expression on a layer by expressionId without removing it. When disabled the property falls back to its keyframed/base value and any stored error for that expression is cleared. `enabled` is required and must be a boolean.

tools.name: list_motion_expression_errors
tools.description: Evaluate every enabled expression in a composition and return the compile/cycle/runtime errors, one entry per failing expression: { layerId, property, expressionId, error }. Use this to see why an attached custom expression is not driving its property (the value silently falls back to the property base on error). Returns an empty list when every expression evaluates cleanly.

tools.name: add_motion_expression_control
tools.description: Add an expression-control effect (Slider/Checkbox/Angle) to a layer. controlType is 'slider' (finite float, default 0), 'checkbox' (0 or 1, coerced), or 'angle' (degrees float, default 0). These render nothing on their own; they are named knobs an expression reads via effect("<name>")("value"). Optional name (defaults 'Slider Control'/'Checkbox Control'/'Angle Control') is the reference key; optional value sets the initial control value. The 'value' param is keyframable at effect.<id>.value (see list_motion_animatable_properties). Returns { effectId, name }.

tools.name: list_motion_shaders
tools.description: Enumerate the built-in GPU shader library for Motion Creator. Returns fill shaders (procedural fills for shape/text layers), effect shaders (post-process effects on any visual layer), and text shaders (per-glyph animator shaders for text layers), each with its parameters (name, label, type, min, max, default, step) and its collection ('Paper' for the Paper Design catalog, null for the original built-ins). Use before set_motion_shader_fill / add_motion_shader_effect / add_motion_text_shader_animator to pick a valid shaderId and know its params. Optional category filter: 'fill', 'effect', or 'text'. Optional collection filter (e.g. 'Paper') narrows to one collection; an unknown collection returns empty lists, not an error.

tools.name: create_ai_shader
tools.description: Register a new AI-authored GPU shader (GLSL + params) into the project's shader library so it can be used like a built-in via set_motion_shader_fill / add_motion_effect / add_motion_text_shader_animator. category is 'fill', 'effect', or 'text'. glsl must be a WebGL2 GLSL ES 3.00 fragment shader following the authoring contract (#version 300 es; in vec2 vUv; uniform vec2 u_resolution; uniform float u_time; out vec4 fragColor; effect/text also declare uniform sampler2D u_input; text also uniform float u_progress; fills must NOT sample u_input). params is an array of { name, label, min, max, default, step, type?, control? }. If the shader fails the contract or GLSL compile, the tool returns INVALID_PARAMS with the error log so you can repair the source and retry. The created shaderId is namespaced 'ai-<slug>-<hash>' and persists with the project.

tools.name: list_ai_shaders
tools.description: List the AI-authored (generated) shaders registered in the current project, each with its id, name, category, and parameters. These also appear in list_motion_shaders under their category.

tools.name: remove_ai_shader
tools.description: Remove an AI-authored (generated) shader from the project's shader library by its shaderId (as returned by create_ai_shader / list_ai_shaders). Built-in shaders cannot be removed.

tools.name: set_motion_shader_fill
tools.description: Paint a shape or text layer with a procedural GPU fill shader. shaderId must be a fill shader from list_motion_shaders (category 'fill'). Supplied params are clamped to each param's [min,max]; unknown param names are ignored and missing ones use the shader default. Shape layers store it on style.fill; text layers store it on style.fillShader (overriding color).

tools.name: clear_motion_shader_fill
tools.description: Remove a procedural GPU fill shader previously applied with set_motion_shader_fill. For a text layer this strips style.fillShader so the layer falls back to its solid color/gradient. For a shape layer this resets style.fill.type to 'solid' (keeping the existing color and opacity) and drops the shader reference. Succeeds as a no-op if the layer has no shader fill. Applies only to shape or text layers.

tools.name: add_motion_effect
tools.description: Add an effect (blur|drop-shadow|glow|color-adjust|invert|grayscale|sepia|levels|sharpen|posterize|directional-blur|noise|radial-blur|displace|backdrop-blur) to a layer with sensible preset defaults (backdrop-blur frosts what is behind the layer, radius ~16). Returns the new effectId.

tools.name: add_motion_shader_effect
tools.description: Add a GPU post-process shader effect to any visual layer. shaderId must be an effect shader from list_motion_shaders (category 'effect'). Supplied params are clamped to each param's [min,max]; unknown param names are ignored and missing ones use the shader default. Returns the new effectId; edit params later with update_motion_effect.

tools.name: update_motion_effect
tools.description: Update a numeric effect parameter (radius|opacity|blur|offsetX|offsetY|intensity|brightness|contrast|saturation|hue|value|...) by effectId. Pass parameter='value' to statically set the control value of an expression-control effect (slider/checkbox/angle) — the same knob add_motion_expression_control seeds and that effect("<name>")("value") reads. Also accepts any parameter of a shader effect, referenced by that shader's param name (as listed by list_motion_shaders).

tools.name: transfer_motion_effect_stack
tools.description: Copy a source layer's complete ordered effect stack, including animated parameters and expressions, to one or more target layers. mode is append (default) or replace. All pasted effects, keyframes, and expressions receive independent identities.

tools.name: remove_motion_effect
tools.description: Remove an effect from a layer by effectId.

tools.name: toggle_motion_effect
tools.description: Enable or disable an effect on a layer by effectId.

tools.name: reorder_motion_effect
tools.description: Move an effect one slot within a layer's effect stack. direction is 'up' (renders earlier — closer to the top of the stack) or 'down' (renders later). Effect order matters: later effects process the output of earlier ones. Returns INVALID_PARAMS if the effect is already at the top (up) or bottom (down) and cannot move further.

tools.name: add_motion_mask
tools.description: Add a rectangle, ellipse, polygon, or path (bezier) mask to a layer. Optional: mode (add|subtract), inverted, feather, expansion (px grow/shrink of the mask edge; positive grows), opacity (0-1 mask strength); for polygon a `points` array of {x,y} normalized [0,1] vertices; for path a `pathPoints` array of >=3 {x,y,inX?,inY?,outX?,outY?} vertices in layer-local pixel coordinates (handles optional). Returns the new maskId.

tools.name: transfer_motion_mask_stack
tools.description: Copy a source layer's complete mask stack, including animated mask properties, path keyframes, and expressions, to one or more target layers. mode is append (default) or replace. Every pasted mask and animation identity is regenerated.

tools.name: update_motion_mask
tools.description: Update a mask's geometry/options by maskId. Optional normalized bounds (x|y|width|height in 0..1), rotation, mode, inverted, feather, expansion, opacity.

tools.name: remove_motion_mask
tools.description: Remove a mask from a layer by maskId.

tools.name: set_motion_mask_path
tools.description: Replace a path mask's bezier vertices. pathPoints is an array of >=3 {x,y,inX?,inY?,outX?,outY?} vertices in layer-local pixel coordinates (handles optional). The mask must have shape:path.

tools.name: add_motion_mask_path_keyframe
tools.description: Add or replace a mask-path keyframe (rotoscoping) at a time on a path mask. Optional pathPoints (>=3 {x,y,inX?,inY?,outX?,outY?} vertices in layer-local pixel coordinates) default to the mask's current path. The mask must have shape:path. Returns the keyframe id.

tools.name: set_motion_track_matte
tools.description: Set, toggle, or clear a track matte on a layer, using another layer as the matte source. type is alpha|alpha-inverted|luma|luma-inverted. Pass sourceLayerId=null to CLEAR the matte entirely. Pass enabled (bool) to enable/disable an existing matte without changing its source (defaults true when a source is given). When updating an existing matte, sourceLayerId and type are optional and merge onto the current matte.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_blend_mode
tools.description: Set a layer's blend mode (see get_capabilities motion.blendModes / blendModes).

tools.name: set_motion_layer_parent
tools.description: Parent one layer to another so it inherits the parent's transform. Pass parentId=null (or omit) to unparent. Cyclic parenting is rejected.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide a motion layer.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock a motion layer.

tools.name: add_motion_shape_modifier
tools.description: Add a shape modifier (trim-paths|repeater|zig-zag|round-corners|wiggle-paths|offset-paths|pucker-bloat|twist) to a shape layer. One modifier per type. Returns the modifierId.

tools.name: update_motion_shape_modifier
tools.description: Update numeric fields on a shape modifier by modifierId (e.g. trim-paths start/end/offset, repeater copies/offset, round-corners radius). Pass a `fields` object of numeric overrides. Pass enabled (bool) to enable/disable (bypass) the modifier without removing it. At least one of fields or enabled is required.

tools.name: remove_motion_shape_modifier
tools.description: Remove a shape modifier from a shape layer by modifierId.

tools.name: add_motion_shape_group
tools.description: Add an intra-layer shape group to a shape layer's contents tree (the AE "Group (Shift+Cmd+G)" / compound-path container). Pass parentGroupId to nest inside an existing group, else it appends to the layer root. mergeMode is none|union|subtract|intersect|exclude (Merge Paths boolean applied to the group's children). Returns the groupId. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: add_motion_shape_to_group
tools.description: Add a path/shape item to a shape layer's contents tree. Pass parentGroupId to place it inside a group, else it appends to the layer root. shapeType is a 2D shape (rectangle|ellipse|path|...). For shapeType 'path' supply pathData (SVG path string) or pathPoints. position {x,y} offsets the item within its parent. Optional style {fill,stroke,...} overrides the inherited group/layer style (omit to inherit). Returns the itemId. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: update_motion_shape_item
tools.description: Patch a shape contents item (group or path) by itemId. patch fields: name, visible; groups also accept transform {anchor,position,scale,rotation,opacity} and mergeMode (none|union|subtract|intersect|exclude); path items also accept shapeType (2D only: rectangle|circle|ellipse|triangle|arrow|line|polygon|path|star — mesh-* 3D types are rejected), width, height, position {x,y}, pathData, style. transform/mergeMode on a path item, or width/height/pathData on a group, are rejected (kind-guard). Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: remove_motion_shape_item
tools.description: Remove a shape contents item (group or path) by itemId from a shape layer, pruning it from wherever it is nested. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: move_motion_shape_item
tools.description: Reorder a shape contents item within its parent (direction up|down). Reordering changes both z-order and merge/operator fold order (document order matters for subtract/exclude). Boundary moves are no-ops. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: add_motion_shape_group_operator
tools.description: Append an operator to a shape group's ordered operator stack (applied left-to-right after the group's merge). operatorType is any of trim-paths|repeater|zig-zag|round-corners|wiggle-paths|offset-paths|pucker-bloat|twist. Duplicates are allowed. Pass params (numeric field overrides, e.g. { amount: 12 } / { angle: 90 }) to seed the operator. Returns the operatorId. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: update_motion_shape_group_operator
tools.description: Update a group operator's numeric fields (e.g. offset-paths.amount, twist.angle, trim-paths start/end) by operatorId. Pass a fields object of numeric overrides and/or enabled (bool) to bypass without removing. At least one of fields or enabled is required. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: remove_motion_shape_group_operator
tools.description: Remove an operator from a shape group's operator stack by operatorId. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: merge_motion_shape_layers
tools.description: Collapse >=2 shape layers into one grouped shape layer with a Merge Paths mode (the AE compound-icon workflow). mode is none|union|subtract|intersect|exclude, folded in the given layerIds order. Each source layer becomes a wrapper group whose transform (position, rotation, scale, anchor, opacity) mirrors the source layer so world placement is preserved; a source with its own contents tree keeps those items verbatim. The source layers are removed and one new shape layer holding the merged group is created (single undoable batch). Non-shape source layers (text/image/etc.) are rejected. Returns { layerId, groupId }. Keyframe any group transform, item path, or operator param via add_motion_keyframe with property ids contents.{itemId}.transform.{positionX|positionY|scaleX|scaleY|rotation|opacity}, contents.{itemId}.pathData, and contents.{itemId}.operator.{operatorId}.{param} (offset-paths.amount, pucker-bloat.amount, twist.angle).

tools.name: add_motion_text_animator
tools.description: Add a per-glyph text animator preset (e.g. text-reveal-up, text-type-on) to a text layer. Returns the animatorId. Optional one-call overrides on top of the preset (each field independently merged): name; enabled (start disabled with false); selector { basedOn: characters|words, start (0-100), end (0-100), offset }; timing { startTime, duration, stagger, direction: forward|reverse|center, easing: linear|ease|ease-in|ease-out }; properties { position {x,y}, scale {x,y}, rotation (deg), opacity (0-1) } (these are the from-values glyphs animate from toward the rest state).

tools.name: update_motion_text_animator
tools.description: Update an existing per-glyph text animator on a text layer by animatorId. Each field is optional and merged onto the current animator (unspecified fields are left intact): name; enabled (routes through the enable/disable path); selector { basedOn: characters|words, start (0-100), end (0-100), offset }; timing { startTime, duration, stagger, direction: forward|reverse|center, easing: linear|ease|ease-in|ease-out }; properties { position {x,y}, scale {x,y}, rotation (deg), opacity (0-1) }. Nested selector/timing/properties objects are themselves partially merged, so passing timing:{duration} changes only the duration.

tools.name: add_motion_text_shader_animator
tools.description: Add a per-glyph GPU shader animator (glyph-dissolve|glyph-glow-wave|chromatic-cascade|scanline-materialize) to a text layer. shaderId must be a text shader from list_motion_shaders (category 'text'). Pass shaderId='' (empty string) to CLEAR/detach the shader from the layer's text animator (back to no GPU shader) — returns { cleared: true }. The shader runs per glyph driven by the animator's staggered progress. Supplied params are clamped to each param's [min,max]; unknown names are ignored and missing ones use the shader default. Optional stagger/duration tune the per-glyph timing. Returns the new animatorId.

tools.name: remove_motion_text_animator
tools.description: Remove a text animator from a text layer by animatorId.

tools.name: set_motion_camera
tools.description: Enable and configure the composition camera. Optional: position x/y/z, zoom, rotation (roll), perspective, and depthOfField (enabled, focusDistance, aperture, maxBlur).

tools.name: add_motion_marker
tools.description: Add a composition marker (a labelled timeline cue) at `time` seconds. Optional label (defaults to 'Marker') and color (#rrggbb). Markers annotate the Motion Creator timeline and are used for snapping. Returns the markerId.

tools.name: update_motion_marker
tools.description: Update a composition marker by markerId. Optional label, time (seconds), color (#rrggbb). Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: remove_motion_marker
tools.description: Remove a composition marker by markerId.

tools.name: animate_motion_camera
tools.description: Keyframe the composition camera over time — comp-level push-in, dolly, orbit, or roll. `position` is an array of { time, x?, y?, z?, easing? } (each channel keyframed independently; omit a channel to leave it alone). `zoom`, `rotation`, and `perspective` are arrays of { time, value, easing? }. Optional `depthOfField` { focusDistance?, aperture?, maxBlur? } enables DOF and sets those values. Times in seconds. Enables the camera automatically. Re-calling upserts keyframes at matching times.

tools.name: animate_motion_light
tools.description: Keyframe a composition light property over time by lightId. `property` is one of light.intensity, light.position.x/y/z, light.radius, light.falloff, light.angle, light.shadowOpacity, light.shadowSoftness. `keyframes` is an array of { time, value, easing? }. Times in seconds. Re-calling upserts keyframes at matching times.

tools.name: set_motion_light_style
tools.description: Update a light's non-numeric style by lightId. Optional: color (#rrggbb or rgba()), castsShadow (bool), name, enabled (bool), type (ambient|point|directional — changing the type renormalizes defaults). Only the fields you pass change. Use update_motion_light / animate_motion_light for numeric properties.

tools.name: set_motion_blur
tools.description: Configure composition-wide motion blur. Optional: enabled (bool), shutterAngle (0-720 deg; higher = more blur), shutterPhase (-360..360 deg), samples (2-32 sub-frame samples). Per-layer opt-in is controlled by set_motion_layer_motion_blur. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: set_motion_layer_motion_blur
tools.description: Enable or disable motion blur for a single layer by layerId (per-layer opt-in). Composition motion blur must also be enabled via set_motion_blur for the effect to render.

tools.name: add_motion_light
tools.description: Add a light (ambient|point|directional) to the composition. Optional: color, intensity, position x/y/z, angle, radius, falloff (light attenuation exponent), castsShadow (bool), shadowOpacity (0-1), shadowSoftness (px blur). Returns the lightId.

tools.name: update_motion_light
tools.description: Update a light's numeric property by lightId. property is one of light.intensity, light.position.x/y/z, light.radius, light.falloff, light.angle, light.shadowOpacity, light.shadowSoftness.

tools.name: remove_motion_light
tools.description: Remove a light from the composition by lightId.

tools.name: create_motion_variable
tools.description: Create a composition variable (text|number|color|boolean|media). Returns the variableId. Variables can be bound to layer targets via bind_motion_variable.

tools.name: update_motion_variable
tools.description: Update a composition variable by variableId. Optional name, value, and variableType (text|number|color|boolean|media). Changing variableType re-coerces the value to the new type (e.g. number -> text). Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: delete_motion_variable
tools.description: Delete a composition variable by variableId. Any layer bindings referencing it become inert. Use with care — bound layers will fall back to their static values.

tools.name: bind_motion_variable
tools.description: Bind a composition variable to a compatible layer target (e.g. text.content, text.color, shape.fill.color, transform.opacity, layer.visible, image.assetId). Use get_motion_composition to find ids.

tools.name: unbind_motion_variable
tools.description: Remove a variable binding from a layer by bindingId.

tools.name: import_svg_composition
tools.description: Import raw SVG markup as a new Motion Creator composition (shapes/text become native motion layers). Returns the new compositionId and layer count.

tools.name: import_lottie_composition
tools.description: Import a Lottie animation JSON object as a new Motion Creator composition. Returns the new compositionId and layer count.

tools.name: import_figma_composition
tools.description: Import a Figma frame JSON export as a new Motion Creator composition. Returns the new compositionId and layer count.

tools.name: add_motion_layers
tools.description: Create MANY layers in ONE call to reconstruct a full UI efficiently. Pass `layers`: an array of specs, each { key?, type (text|shape|image|group|null|adjustment), name?, x?, y? (pixel center), width?, height?, rotation?, opacity?, startTime?, duration?, parentKey? (reference another spec's key), parentId?, shapeType?, style? (fill/stroke/shadow/cornerRadius — see set_motion_shape_style), text?, textStyle? (fontFamily/fontSize/fontWeight/color/align/lineHeight/letterSpacing), assetId? (image), fit? }. Returns data.layerIds keyed by each spec's `key` plus data.createdLayerIds in order. Use this then arrange_motion_layers + animate_motion_layers.

tools.name: set_motion_shape_style
tools.description: Set the full visual style of a shape layer so any card/button/panel look is reproducible. Optional: shapeType (rectangle|circle|ellipse|line|polygon|star|triangle|arrow|...), width, height, fill { type: solid|gradient|none, color, opacity, gradient: { type: linear|radial|conic, angle, center {x,y}, stops: [{offset 0..1, color, opacity?}] } }, stroke { color, width, opacity, dashArray, dashOffset, lineCap, lineJoin, gradient }, shadow { color, blur, offsetX, offsetY, spread?, inset? }, shadows [array of shadow], cornerRadius, cornerRadii { topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft }, points (star), innerRadius (star 0..1).

tools.name: add_motion_ui_component
tools.description: Add a high-level UI component built from native shape/text layers and grouped together. componentType is one of button|card|input|nav-bar|avatar|badge|icon-button. props (all optional): label, title, body, placeholder, items (nav links), x, y (pixel center), width, height, cornerRadius, backgroundColor, textColor, accentColor, fontSize, shadow (boolean), assetIdForAvatar, startTime, duration. Returns data.groupId and data.childIds — everything stays editable as normal layers.

tools.name: arrange_motion_layers
tools.description: Lay out layers precisely. mode is stack-vertical, stack-horizontal, or grid. Pass layerIds in the desired order. For stacks: gap, align (start|center|end), originX/originY (the top-left pixel anchor of the run). For grid: columns, gap, rowGap, originX/originY. Positions are computed from each layer's visual size.

tools.name: align_motion_layers
tools.description: Align layers by edge or center. alignment is left|center-x|right|top|center-y|bottom. relativeTo is selection (default) or composition.

tools.name: distribute_motion_layers
tools.description: Evenly distribute 3+ layers along an axis (horizontal|vertical) so spacing between centers is equal.

tools.name: group_motion_layers
